basis: All 25 accepted initial reports and existing discovery evidence; independent comparative challenge. This is potential decision-changing research value, not a measured highest-EV ranking or top-four recommendation.

reviewOrder.question: Identify recent unique legal/counseling outcomes, incremental safety and net household gains after realistic alternatives, court burdens and full transfer-payer incidence.
Test training and low-vision health and net earnings outcomes after tuition, time, public alternatives and consolidated costs.
Resolve ongoing maternal recovery capacity and funding disruption, then completed treatment, health and net caregiver/work resources.
Use matched case/cost evidence but distinguish changed housing/safety outcomes from awards, including payer incidence and Houston attribution.
Identify unique distress improvements after repeat contacts, 988 substitution and full volunteer costs; calls do not establish deaths prevented.
Deduplicate dated safety/counseling/economic outputs and test culturally specific access against alternatives, including full harms and household burdens.
Connect unique recipients and service months to causal nutrition/connection and signed net food and caregiver resources.
Test additional timely diagnosis and completed treatment rather than screening/navigation volume, with treatment costs and screening harms.
Test implemented exposure change, coalition attribution, finite delay and signed compliance/jobs effects rather than monitoring volume.
Identify incremental sewage/flood implementation beyond existing obligations with finite local health/resources and full payer burdens.

substitutions.reason: Matched legal case/award evidence permits testing broad safety and resource outcomes; the existing narrow surgery/grant channel has no established new-gift bottleneck.
Current recovery funding disruption may change health and caregiver/work resources; the terminated dental staffing channel has already received a focused source audit.
Dated culturally specific safety and economic outputs permit a sharper comparison with AVDA than a clinic with no current unique treatment cohort.

acceptanceLimits: Selection creates zero beta or featured credits and no organization research minutes. Missing evidence is not zero impact; unlike initial partial-channel prices are not comparable full-portfolio or marginal-gift EV. Every deep review must assess health and signed net resources, preserve initial diagnostics, pass original-source/arithmetic and independent challenge, and synchronize accepted prices. Reconsider selection only if material new evidence warrants it, not serial polishing.
next: One bounded approximately 15-minute AVDA deep review, then independent acceptance; root alone integrates. Batch coherent accepted reports for release. Four features follow comparative deep review.
